instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: When a sample is grown out again, what may some of the plants cross with?
items.evidence: a few cross with the neighbouring row
items.explanation: Regrowing a sample makes a selection each time: some seeds fail to germinate, and some cross with plants in the neighbouring row.

items.prompt: Which piece of equipment failing has been the commonest cause of losses?
items.evidence: an alarm that stayed silent over a long weekend has been the commonest cause of loss over the past fifty years
items.explanation: The speaker says it is not the freezer that loses a collection — a freezer that fails while somebody is watching costs nothing — but the alarm: an alarm that stayed silent over a long weekend.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: Which piece of equipment failing has been the commonest cause of losses?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Tohum bankasinda akla gelen tek kritik ekipman dondurucu; soru kendi baginda tek cevabi birakiyordu ve 3/3 turda bilindi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 3: tur 9'un son cumlesi sesli rakiple yeniden yazildi — 'it is not the freezer that loses a collection — freezers do fail, but a freezer that fails while somebody is watching costs you nothing — it is the alarm, and an alarm that stayed silent over a long weekend has been the commonest cause of loss over the past fifty years.' Dunyanin bekledigi dondurucu artik celdirici, cevap alarm. Cumle/tur sayisi degismedi; ayni turdaki ikinci-saha kurali cumlesi (alistirma paketinin dayanagi) aynen korundu.

items.prompt: In wet tropical forest, what proportion of the tree species have seeds that cannot be dried and frozen?
items.evidence: in wet tropical forest the last review put it at a third of the tree species there
items.explanation: Eight per cent is the global figure the speaker calls a flattering average; in wet tropical forest the last review put it at a third of the tree species.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: What term is used for seeds that can be dried and frozen without being killed?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: 'Kurutulup dondurulabilen tohumlara ne ad verilir' duz bir terim tanimi sorusuydu; konusma duyulmadan 3/3 turda bilindi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1+2: soru ayni turun icinde baska bir cevap noktasina tasindi (yeni L3-S4-29) ve o nokta icin tur 10'un son cumlesine yan cumlecik sigdirildi: '...though that global average flatters the problem: in wet tropical forest the last review put it at a third of the tree species there.' Kuresel yuzde sekiz artik celdirici. 'Orthodox' terimi seste duruyor, artik sorulmuyor. Cumle/tur sayisi degismedi, soru sirasi (38 tur 9 < 39 tur 10 < 40 tur 11) korundu.

items.prompt: Freezing the embryo has to be worked out species by species. For roughly how many species has that been done so far?
items.evidence: stands at about thirty species so far
items.explanation: Freezing the embryo in liquid nitrogen has to be worked out one species at a time, and the speaker says it stands at about thirty species so far.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: How cold is it kept when only the embryo is frozen in liquid nitrogen?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sivi azotun sicakligi sabit bir fizik degeri; soru konusmadan bagimsiz cevaplanabiliyordu ve 3/3 turda bilindi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1+2: soru ayni turun icinde yeni bir cevap noktasina tasindi (L3-S4-30). Tur 11'de 'which works for a growing number of species but has to be worked out one species at a time' ifadesi 'though the method has to be worked out one species at a time and stands at about thirty species so far' oldu; sayi konusmanin kendi sectigi bir deger. Eksi 196 seste duruyor, artik sorulmuyor. Cumle/tur sayisi degismedi.
